§ 01 · The Program

Real brands,
real decisions.

From defining a target audience and positioning a brand, to handling a PR crisis, launching a product campaign, and presenting a comprehensive annual plan, every scenario drops you into a genuine marketing or branding situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Forty-four strategy-focused scenarios and fifty-six campaign-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real marketing judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a marketer or brand manager faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across brand strategy, campaign execution, crisis response, and growth planning.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound marketing judgment under pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

scenario.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Marketing Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping marketers and brand professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in marketing isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–B2 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, marketing and branding roles in English — Mr. Gad Marketing & Branding is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the brand moments you'll actually face.
